rows.grounds: vocative address to the goddess Cāmuṇḍā
bahuvrīhi compound describing the goddess's face adorned with a garland of skulls
vocative epithet identifying the goddess as great knowledge; mahāvidyā denotes a supreme goddess form
bahuvrīhi compound attributing great strength to the goddess

items.question: By what fierce attributes and supreme powers is the goddess Cāmuṇḍā invoked?
premises: The goddess is directly addressed as Cāmuṇḍā.
She is described as having a face adorned with a garland of skulls.
She is identified as great knowledge and great strength.
items.inference: Cāmuṇḍā is invoked as a fierce goddess embodying terrifying iconography, supreme knowledge, and immense power.
items.plain_english: O Cāmuṇḍā, whose face is adorned with a garland of skulls, sharp-fanged one, O great knowledge, O great strength!
